Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India has announced the scheme for incentives for nutritional support to TB patients. This scheme called “Nikshay Payment Yojana (NPY)”. Financial incentive of Rs.500/- per month given for each notified TB patient for duration for which the patient is on anti-TB treatment. The scheme is registered under Direct Benefit Transfer.
